titulo_es: Adjust tone, courtesy and level of formality

texto: Write complaints and requests with tone, courtesy and precise data. **Jag bifogar relevanta handlingar** means «I attach the relevant documents». Analyzes the scope and registration of the expression. Distinguish the data of the interpretation, check what evidence it holds and practice a precise paraphrase. Sequence 3 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
